X and O take turns placing one stone at a time on the empty squares of a 9×9 board. X plays first. Whoever connects exactly five of their own stones without a gap in one horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line wins immediately. Six or more connected stones do not count as a win.
The board is written with rows A to I (A at the top) and columns 1 to 9, and an empty square is ".". A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "E5".
